description: How OneAI reads what arrives in this workspace.

fields.label: Read Files Attached to Records
fields.description: Scans and photos attached on a form are read too, on behalf of whoever attached them.

fields.label: Most Pages Read
fields.description: A scan longer than this is read up to here. The rest stays searchable by its name.

fields.label: Confidence Floor
fields.description: Below this, what OneAI would make or change waits in Needs a Look.

fields.label: Audit What OneAI Does
fields.description: A second agent checks each document's actions, approves what is right and sends what is wrong to a person.

fields.label: Leave Unmatched Files in Place
fields.description: Files that belong to no record stay where they arrived instead of going to a folder for their kind and year.

fields.label: Quiet Minutes
fields.description: People write in bursts. OneAI acts once a matter has been quiet this long, except on money or deadlines due within a day.

fields.label: Household
fields.description: A household keeps no books. No drafts are made, and Spending shows what was bought.

fields.label: Submit Matching E-Invoices
fields.description: An e-invoice from a known supplier, billed from an order and ready, is submitted by OneAI. Off unless switched on.

name: Intake Settings
